name: Rouge Shop
description: In the lively and bustling market, there is an elegant and beautiful building. There are all kinds of rouge and gouache inside, which is overwhelming. This rouge shop, which is very popular among women, is slightly different from the surrounding restaurants and pawnshops. It is colorful yet elegant, making it eye-catching. Its details are exquisite, with peonies blooming in the carved windows and lanterns hanging high on the eaves, showing the charm of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Come and collect a set of Tang-style buildings such as Rouge Shop and Fengman Building, and experience the comfortable life of the ancients in the assembled world.
